claims.assertion: Mari describes Cyndriel as a high-frequency world where stellar radiation supports life and its quiet environment encourages introspection.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Cyndriel is the only Taygetan colony outside the Pleiades and can be visited as a tourist destination with respect for its inhabitants.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She calls them higher-density light beings.

claims.assertion: She says Cyndriel has an unstable time offset and cannot be reached by artificial portals; travel requires a starship and gradual frequency adjustment.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
